# Euro Detailing

> Owner-operated mobile car detailing in Newton, Massachusetts. Eric Salas comes
> to you anywhere within 10 miles of Newton. 5.0 stars across 13 Google reviews.

Contact: +1-781-290-3040 · eurodetailinginfo@gmail.com
Hours: Mon-Sun, 8am-8pm
Service area: Newton, Waltham, Watertown, Brighton, Weston, Belmont, Needham, Wellesley, Allston, Brookline, Dedham, Boston

## Services

Every service is priced by vehicle size (Sedan / SUV / Truck-XL) and comes in two
levels: Basic, for a car that is kept up, and Deep Clean — also called Premium —
for one that is not. Deep Clean/Premium always costs more than Basic; it is never
the same price. Prices below are for a Sedan; SUV and Truck/XL cost more. Full
per-size pricing is on each service page.

- Interior Detailing (https://www.eurodetailing.com/services/interior) — Basic from $105, Deep Clean/Premium
  from $165. Steam clean, stain removal, leather conditioning, odor treatment.
- Exterior Detailing (https://www.eurodetailing.com/services/exterior) — Basic from $70, Deep Clean/Premium
  from $105. Foam bath hand wash, clay bar decontamination, up to six months of sealant.
- Interior + Exterior (https://www.eurodetailing.com/services/bundle) — Basic from $150, Deep Clean/Premium
  from $230. Both in a single visit, cheaper than booking them separately.

## Membership

Recurring detailing at a lower per-visit rate (https://www.eurodetailing.com/membership). Three cadences:
every 2 weeks (from $209/month, 2 visits), monthly (from $119/month), and every
3 months (from $135/visit). No contract, cancel any time. Members get a standing
discount on every add-on.

## Add-ons

Any of these can be added to any package (https://www.eurodetailing.com/addons):

- Pet hair removal — $35+. Embedded hair pulled from carpet and upholstery, not just vacuumed over.
- Seat extraction — $49.99+. Hot-water extraction that pulls dirt and staining up out of the foam.
- Engine bay detail — $49.99. Degreased, rinsed and dressed so the bay looks as clean as the paint.
- Mold removal — $49.99. Treated at the source and neutralized, not perfumed over.
- Clay bar treatment — $49.99. Lifts bonded road film and sap so the paint is genuinely smooth again.
- Car waxing — $34.99. A hand-applied wax layer for depth of gloss and a few months of protection.
- Plastic mat restoration — $25+. Faded plastic mats brought back to a clean, even finish.
